subject: SCN-DOGTHORN-TREE variant 2 highest crown cluster
scope: Independent generation-authoring visual inspection only; no art edits, generation, native or game checks
method: Read source-packet.json and visually inspected all four bound images through view_image. The closeup provides a contrasting dark green background; the neutral master supplies the full tree context.
verdict: Floating or unsupported highest crown cluster is not demonstrated.
confidence: High that the visible silhouette permits coherent foliage continuity; moderate about the hidden woody support, which is not directly observable.
evidence: In crown-source-closeup.png, the highest leaf mass extends down and right into the upper-right neighboring mass. Their dark outlined foliage overlaps at the lower-right side of the highest mass; no complete band of green background isolates the highest mass.
The green negative-space pocket below and left of that overlap is open on the left but does not form a closed moat around the highest mass. It therefore does not demonstrate detachment.

In variant-2-neutral-master.png, that neighboring upper-right foliage continues into the central and right crown. The visible right-rising trunk/branch enters this connected crown from below. This is a coherent possible concealed support route, rather than direct proof of its exact branch layout.

wood-ownership-comparison.png does not expose a continuous woody path to the highest cluster. It isolates visible wood ownership and leaves wood hidden by foliage unobserved; this absence does not by itself establish structural failure.
registration-comparison.png repeats the same connected crown relationship in neutral and G+w presentations, including reduced display sizes.
limits: This is a 2D occluded illustration; no specific concealed branch geometry or botanical attachment is established.

The source packet requires a higher central lobe and lower right-spreading crown for variant 2, with crooked visible wood and broad irregular clustered foliage. It does not require every concealed supporting branch to be visible.
No conclusion is made about native integration, game rendering, or other acceptance criteria.
recommended_action: Do not require a crown repair solely on the earlier floating-cluster allegation. Retain it as plausible hidden continuity unless additional evidence shows an actual separated silhouette or contradictory support geometry.
